message.content:
**Lucas Adams** plays Noah Newman on *The Young and the Restless*.[1][2]

CBS’s cast page says Adams joined the soap in November 2025 as Noah Newman.[2] TV Insider also reports that he was cast in the role, noting that Noah had previously been played by Rory Gibson, Robert Adamson, and Kevin Schmidt.[1]
